items.title: Maria Vorontsova, Vladimir Putin's daughter, leads fight against aging
items.description: While Russia wages war in Ukraine at a staggering cost in human lives, the Russian leader is pouring substantial funds into scientific research on longevity. This project is overseen by his eldest daughter, a prominent endocrinologist.

items.title: Yemen war makes reaching assistance too dangerous for many
items.description: More than 280,000 people have now been displaced by fighting in Yemen and many vulnerable people are unable to access lifesaving relief because it is too dangerous to do so, the UN refugee agency (UNHCR) said on Friday.
